response_property_constraints.description: The object type for each track item must be the literal string 'track'.
The Spotify URI for the track must follow the Spotify URI format 'spotify:track:<id>'.
A link to the Web API endpoint providing full details of the track must be a valid URL (http/https).
A URL to a 30 second preview (MP3 format) of the track; must be a valid URL when present (it may also be null).
The disc number must be a positive integer (usually 1 unless the album consists of more than one disc).
The number of the track must be a positive integer.
The track length in milliseconds must be a non-negative integer.
Whether or not the track has explicit lyrics; must be a boolean.
Part of the response when Track Relinking is applied; if present must be a boolean.
The object type for each artist must be the literal string 'artist'.
The Spotify URI for the artist must follow the Spotify URI format 'spotify:artist:<id>'.
A link to the Web API endpoint providing full details of the artist must be a valid URL (http/https).
A link to the Web API endpoint returning the full result of the request must be a valid URL (http/https).
The maximum number of items in the response must be a non-negative integer.
The offset of the items returned must be a non-negative integer.
The total number of items available to return must be a non-negative integer.
URL to the next page of items must be a valid URL (http/https) or null if none.
URL to the previous page of items must be a valid URL (http/https) or null if none.

request_response_constraints.description: The 'limit' value in the response must equal the 'limit' request parameter value (the maximum number of items to return as set in the query).
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The maximum number of items to return
